bio: Natural hair, braiding and the hands behind the style. Patterns, patience and a very good comb.
avatar: Portrait of a woman in her late 20s with dark skin and intricate box braids with gold cuffs, warm studio light, bright smile, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a hair salon station with combs, colourful hair extensions and warm mirror lights, subject across the middle band, cinematic

videos.title: Box braids, hands only
videos.description: Section by section: the rhythm of braiding.
videos.still: Vertical close-up photograph of a pair of hands braiding long sections of black hair into box braids, warm soft light, shallow depth of field, no face, no text
videos.motion: The hands cross and pull the strands in a steady rhythm, the braid lengthens, subtle macro drift.

videos.title: Salon morning, first client

videos.motion: Morning light slowly warms across the station and dust motes float, gentle push-in.

videos.title: Gold cuffs and a finished braid

videos.motion: The braid swings gently and the gold cuffs catch the light, slow camera drift.

videos.title: Colour test: copper to plum

videos.still: Wide photograph of hair strand swatches in copper, burgundy and plum fanned on a white marble table with soft daylight, no people, no text
videos.motion: Light shifts across the strands making the colours shimmer, slow horizontal pan.
